audit.definition: Actual commits attributed to the owner as author or committer, with implementation commits preferred. No push timestamp, repository update, or pull-request-only evidence qualifies. Configuration/data/assets-only and documentation-only repositories are separate review classes.
audit.method: Paginated owned-repository enumeration, cross-checked against each organization; commits on default and all current branches, filtering to the past year; changed file paths inspected, merge-only commits skipped. Stop after a qualifying example, not a total contribution count.
limitations: Unpushed local work, inaccessible/deleted repositories and commits reachable only from deleted branches are outside this GitHub audit.
File-path classification establishes the kind of work, not product quality or a new feature; configuration and assets may be maintenance only.
A linked repository is not automatically a separate product. Previously removed Fleet projects remain removed.
